name: m5-kwu-scaling-async

variantDescriptions.t1: one compile at a time, 40 warmup compiles (6 left C2 still compiling in the measurement: 4.5G JIT instructions per op, job 569)
variantDescriptions.t8: 8 independent compiles at once, each its own `Global`; 6 warmup iterations = 48 compiles

description: Where do 8 independent compiles lose against one? async-profiler cpu, alloc and lock (wall is `m5-kwu-scaling-wall`: JMH takes one event per session) over the measurement iterations, with the JDK events of the window (jfrsync, plus G1 promotion events for a promotion census), at 1 and at 8 concurrent compiles.

Build `claude/uniques-audit` `41986b33ea` with `-Yuniques-layout:chunked-weak` and `-Yuniques-uncache all` (ChunkedInterner(weak = true), types made in the weak scopes not interned). Scala corpus, 24 GB G1 heap, laptop, one fork per variant.
